item.title: Jejunu: The Curious Embodiment of a Manmade Famine (Looking for Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: Jejunu was discovered after a few strange, misfortunate, events that lead to the death of several pets and persons. Jejunu’s origins are unknown, but clues come along the way. Researchers find out, the hard way, it makes humans dangerously hungry. Jejunu may seem like just another SCP, but it soon becomes clear it desires knowledge about the foundation. For malicious reasons? Maybe. It seems to desire knowledge that it, more specifically, should not have.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: After this SCP is captured, researchers in the foundation interview this SCP and begin to see, besides being extremely hungry, it’s just as curious about them as they are about it. A few interviews and tests lead to the discovery of it’s abilities and it’s constant need to eat. Jejunu makes an escape, learns a few things about the facility, and is subsequently placed back into confinement with ease. With each interview it becomes more uncomfortable and hungry until an incident inevitably happens.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention Grabber: I want the reader to really question this SCP’s mindset and origins. Are this SCP’s abilities controlled or involuntary? Does it have a conscience or is it just faking? I also wanted the reader to ask the question: Is the foundation trying to learn more about this SCP or is this SCP trying to learn more bout the foundation? What is the purpose of it's needless questions? This SCP is planning something isn't it?

Additional Notes: I am new here and would love criticism to help with my writing! I tend to ramble and I would enjoy it if somebody stopped me from doing so in my writing.
